integrity: All claims concern exact algebra and a sequential asymptotic; supplementary finite computations are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Fair adjacent two-tap averaging, finite odd cyclic groups, fixed-depth large-cycle limit; no uniform joint depth/cycle limit. Older equivalent Euler spline or circulant-inverse expression may exist.
title: Euler-zigzag amplification law for repeated binomial smoothing on odd cycles
